IS 1261 : 1959 Code of practice for seam welding in mild steelUDC 621.791.056 : 669.141.24MTD 11Reaffirmed 20191 Scope1.1 This standard relates to seam welding in mild steel wherethe total added thickness of the components to be welded does notexceed 8.0 mm.1.2 When it is necessary or desirable to seam weld sheets ofwidely dissimilar thicknesses, there may be limitations on theratio of the thickness of the material being welded. Further,special techniques for welding may have to be employed.2 ReferenceIS 2 : 1949Rules forRounding Off Numerical Values
